Message:
ipv6: Handle all fib6_nh in a nexthop in rt6_do_redirect

Use nexthop_for_each_fib6_nh and fib6_nh_find_match to find the
fib6_nh in a nexthop that correlates to the device and gateway
in the rt6_info.
